en: Sepia postcard showing an industrial cement works at the foot of a hill with multiple bottle-shaped kilns and a tall smokestack. The title at the top gives the city name Brașov in Romanian, Hungarian, and German, and identifies the site as the cement factory at Csigahégy/Schneckenberg. The reverse has printed headings for a postcard in Hungarian and Romanian and a publisher credit.
